    20→/**

    23→export function detectProductColor(product: Product): string[] {
    24→  const text = `${product.name} ${product.visualDescription || ''}`.toLowerCase()
    25→  const colors: string[] = []
    26→
    27→  // Check against all known color palette keywords
    28→  const allColorKeywords = new Set<string>()
    29→  Object.values(COLOR_PALETTES).forEach(palette => {
    30→    palette.forEach(color => allColorKeywords.add(color.toLowerCase()))
    31→  })
    32→
    33→  // Add common color names
    34→  const commonColors = [
    35→    'white', 'black', 'gray', 'grey', 'beige', 'brown', 'red', 'pink',
    36→    'orange', 'yellow', 'green', 'blue', 'navy', 'purple', 'gold', 'silver',
    37→    'olive', 'taupe', 'cream', 'tan', 'khaki', 'sand', 'camel', 'chocolate',
    38→    'mocha', 'ivory', 'charcoal', 'denim', 'forest'
    39→  ]
    40→
    41→  commonColors.forEach(color => allColorKeywords.add(color))
    42→
    43→  // Also check product colors array if available
    44→  if (product.colors && Array.isArray(product.colors)) {
    45→    product.colors.forEach(color => {
    46→      const lowerColor = color.toLowerCase()
    47→      colors.push(lowerColor)

    49→    })
    50→  }
    51→
    52→  // Detect colors from text

    62→}

    67→export function getPaletteCompatibility(colors: string[]): ColorPalette | null {
